mapper.select: select * from question order by id
select * from question where enabled = 1 order by id
mapper.insert: insert into question (title, description, difficulty, tags, reference_sql, explanation, order_sensitive, enabled, created_at) values (#{title}, #{description}, #{difficulty}, #{tags}, #{referenceSql}, #{explanation}, #{orderSensitive}, #{enabled}, now())
mapper.update: update question set title = #{title}, description = #{description}, difficulty = #{difficulty}, tags = #{tags}, reference_sql = #{referenceSql}, explanation = #{explanation}, order_sensitive = #{orderSensitive}, enabled = #{enabled} where id = #{id}
